scripts.build: npm run build -w @gyeol/contracts && npm run build -w @gyeol/api && npm run build -w @gyeol/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gyeol/contracts && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @gyeol/contracts && npm run build -w @gyeol/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/integration.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w @gyeol/web && npm exec -w @gyeol/web cap sync android
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.catalog:sync: npm run build -w @gyeol/contracts && npm run build -w @gyeol/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/sync-catalog.mjs
scripts.test:live: npm run build -w @gyeol/contracts && npm run build -w @gyeol/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/live-smoke.mjs
